component.name: Madeira
component.summary: Run Windows PC games under a bundled Wine runtime

description.p: Madeira launches Windows x86-64 PC games using a fully self-contained Wine runtime. It bundles Wine, DXVK, VKD3D-Proton and (on ARM64 hosts) FEX-Emu translation, so users never install system Wine or 32-bit multilib libraries. The game runs in a private Wine prefix unde XDG data paths; the default ~/.wine prefix is never touched.

Graphics fall back automatically from DXVK/VKD3D (Vulkan) to WineD3D (OpenGL) on systems without Vulkan-capable drivers. The wrapper cleans up wineserver and all game processes on exit — including after crashes — and restores the desktop resolution.
First production Linux packaging: bundled Wine WoW64 runtime, DXVK/VKD3D with WineD3D fallback, XDG prefix isolation, X11/Wayland handling, robust teardown, and diagnostics mode.
